title: Log Recipes
description: Log Recipes is a simple mod that adds a crafting recipe to turn four planks back into one log of the same wood type. It's a small change that gives you more control over your resources and makes crafting more efficient.
body:
Log Recipes
Welcome to Log Recipes, a simple but incredibly useful mod that I created to make your building and crafting life easier. Have you ever cut down a tree and realized you needed the logs, not the planks? This mod adds a straightforward recipe that lets you craft a log block from four of its corresponding planks. It’s a small change that saves you a lot of time and makes resource management more flexible!

What's Included:
This mod adds a single, simple crafting recipe for every type of wood log in the game. You can now craft one log block from four planks of the same wood type. For example, you can take four Oak Planks and craft them back into a single Oak Log.
